visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video features a young man centered in the frame, wearing a grey sweatshirt, indoors with soft, bright lighting against a plain wall. He is interacting with an augmented reality (AR) filter that displays a red-and-white striped path leading towards him. Along this path, various wooden boards appear as obstacles, each featuring a unique image—such as a creepy character, a vintage airplane, and a banana with a monkey's face—and accompanying text. The man shifts his head slightly as if navigating these virtual hurdles while looking directly at the camera. (2) Upon reaching the end of the AR path, a digital burst of colorful confetti fills the screen. The man transitions from a concentrated expression to a wide, joyful smile, raising his right fist in a triumphant celebratory gesture. A final image of a shark on a board remains on the screen as green 'You Win' text appears, marking the successful completion of the interactive game.
